description: Final committed-source production planner/FIFO/encoder comparison for Guacamole private.6, with the default partial-batch ceiling of 12.

baseline.build_context: server component of the existing build-f710301df private.5 source export
baseline.provenance_note: The benchmark-stage image has no OCI source-revision label; the baseline revision is established by its preserved private.5 build context, not inferred from a missing label.

method.full_matrix: Nine workloads in baseline/adaptive mode order, then adaptive/baseline order. Each mode runs all nine workloads before the next mode.
method.balanced_text: Scrolling and partial redraw in baseline, fixed, adaptive, fixed, baseline, adaptive mode order. Each mode runs both text workloads. Fixed uses the same committed candidate with full-pool admission.
method.timed_work: Raw-context pixel copy, dirty detection, planner/copy search, production FIFO, actual codec workers, frame completion and serialization to a shared discard socket. Fixture generation and initial setup are excluded.
method.limitations: Synthetic pixels only. No capture, RDP transport, browser decoding/painting, Wi-Fi, physical input delay or source frame pacing. Host scheduling and thermal/mode-order variation remain possible.

metadata_notes.baseline_zero_counters: Baseline admission/plan metadata fields are zero because the old library lacks the new counter/control interfaces; these mean unavailable, not zero rendering or encoder activity.
metadata_notes.test_active_cap_one: A harness test_active_cap value of 1 selects the reviewed default policy, which is 12 for this committed source; it does not request one active encoder.
metadata_notes.percentile_aggregation: Summary p50/p95 values are arithmetic means of per-run percentile summaries, not percentiles computed from pooled raw frame timings. Per-frame timing samples are not available in the harness JSON.
metadata_notes.cpu_aggregation: CPU summaries are arithmetic means of per-run process CPU time per frame, with the same sample count in each run.
metadata_notes.fixed_mode: Fixed and adaptive use the same committed candidate library. The baseline uses the preceding private.5 library.

interpretation: Balanced text measurements show modest CPU savings with roughly unchanged scrolling p95 and a small redraw p95 cost. The initial 15% scrolling-latency improvement target was not demonstrated. Full-matrix mode-order variation prevents treating the first forward run alone as a consistent regression or speedup. Real desktop acceptance remains necessary.

result.measurement: production display planner, copy search, FIFO, workers, codecs and serialization to a shared discard socket
result.limitations: synthetic fixtures; no capture, RDP transport, browser, Wi-Fi, physical input or frame pacing; copied pixels/planner/encoding included, fixture generation excluded
result.fixture_note: scroll-text translates existing text; partial-text-redraw changes glyph contents; full-window cases preserve actual non-4K dimensions
